title: Lefschetz theorems on quasi-projective varieties
statementParaphrase: For a nonsingular X−Z, hyperplanes L in an open dense subset yield X−Z homotopy equivalent to L∩(X−Z) with cells of indices at least dim_C X attached.
scope: Statement and printed/PDF pagination visually checked; no independent verification of its proof. Application in fourfold checked separately.

title: Morse Theory
statementParaphrase: A complex analytic manifold of complex dimension k, bianalytically embedded as a closed subset of C^n, has the homotopy type of a k-dimensional CW complex.
scope: Statement and printed/PDF pagination visually checked; no independent verification of its proof. Application in fourfold checked separately.
